rites.name: Osithis
rites.text: Osithis is the concept of resonance that binds the first roots of Siluanora as they condense out of the undated Singing. It is less a being than a standing pattern that other sounds lean upon to hold their shape.

rites.name: Xaisora
rites.text: Xaisora is the concept of the threshold-hinge, the idea that a door is only as true as the promise that holds it shut. In the Courts of Siluanora it was named during the Age of Sundering, when the councils first argued over which bonds could bear the weight of a world's leaving.

rites.name: Merillium
rites.text: A ballad of tender longing that a wandering singer performs to declare affection toward a beloved healer. It is sung when one lover wishes to express deep devotion.

rites.name: Veontanum
rites.text: A ritual method in which one draws lines and fills buckets with grains of sand. The text gives no further detail about its purpose.

rites.name: Nuemiolora
rites.text: Nuemiolora is the concept of a binding light that was first kindled in the Fall of Siluanora, when the Sundering split the worlds into Shards. It is said to have sealed the Pact between the groves and the young kingdoms during the Age of the first sovereign, so that living roots and crowned hands could share one sky.

rites.name: Seranor
rites.text: A simple method of breathing that any person can learn to form floating, shimmering spheres of air. If the method is done wrong, the sphere sinks to the ground and bursts with an unpleasant noise.

rites.name: Ukalaramuta
rites.text: Ukalaramuta is the concept of the threshold that lets a living boundary hold its shape, and in Siluanora it is the principle by which walls are sung into being and kept standing through the long Walled Age. Its tenders call it the patience of stone that remembers being raised. Where it is strong, groves grow over the old ramparts and the first sovereign's roads stay open.

rites.name: Leontanum
rites.text: A jittery, stiff-limbed step performed on the dance floor during a single gathering. It is recorded only in one tale of a festival night.

rites.name: Silalinna
rites.text: Silalinna is the sea-goddess of the Drowned Tiers, a sovereign who keeps the tides in balance from a coral citadel beneath the reef. She is said to have once calmed a rift between two storm-titans by singing a single note that silenced the sky for a day.

rites.name: Venuamarwen
rites.text: Venuamarwen is a sentient flame of the Arcane realm that burns only where water is most stubborn, feeding on the sulk of cold depths and the glee of anyone who dares to light it. Its wild, flickering temper has scorched whole harbors, yet it can be coaxed into warming a lonely hearth with a single soft note. Wise sea-folk say its true weakness is not water but being ignored.

rites.name: Eluanneth
rites.text: Eluanneth is a crimson wraith woven from stray current, shaped like a grinning skull and fed by the hum of sleeping machines. It slips into any powered device in an empty dwelling and rules it as a jealous keeper until someone cuts the flow.

rites.name: Venaellae
rites.text: Venaellae is a sealed heart-core of woven light that governs the emotional tides of the Arcane realm, able to pass feeling from one soul to another across any distance. When its bearer is wronged beyond endurance, the core fractures and scatters its resonance outward, shaking the shape of whatever it touches.

rites.name: Elinnalora
rites.text: Elinnalora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Siluanora, a pair of paired breathing-engines that draw in the air of the sky and hold it as a living tide. In the sixth era it is said to exhale storms that crack the vaults of mountains.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is an arcane-era realm within Siluanora where the boundaries between dreamers and the powers they chase blur, and a self-proclaimed guardian stumbles into cosmic mischief. Its sky-lanterns are said to hold the echo of a failed hero's ambition, which still rattles the valleys when disturbed.

rites.name: Iloranlarum
rites.text: Iloranlarum is the concept of the branching of endings in Siluanora, the force by which the Three Futures are weighed and one is set aside to become the Library's shelved record. In the era of the Record it is the quiet hand that decides which possibility is kept and which is archived.

rites.name: Ukalaroma
rites.text: Ukalaroma is the concept of the unwritten branch, the quiet hinge where a single decision in Siluanora splits the future into three paths. It is not a being but the principle that the Library keeps every outcome on its own shelf, waiting to be read.
